long_biography.plain_text:
When Jerzy Starak acquired Polpharma, he chose to preserve its pharmaceutical-chemistry operation despite sustained losses and advice to close it. Four years of restructuring brought the segment back to growth. The decision reveals the patient approach with which the Polish owner modernised the former state company and consolidated a wider medicines business.

Starak extended that long horizon into biological medicines, establishing Polpharma Biologics and backing research and production facilities for biosimilars. Beyond the group, he created the Polpharma Scientific Foundation to fund medical and pharmaceutical research. The Starak Family Foundation also makes the family's collection of modern Polish art publicly accessible and supports young students and artists.
long_biography.html:
When Jerzy Starak acquired Polpharma, he chose to preserve its pharmaceutical-chemistry operation despite sustained losses and advice to close it. Four years of restructuring brought the segment back to growth. The decision reveals the patient approach with which the Polish owner modernised the former state company and consolidated a wider medicines business.

Starak extended that long horizon into biological medicines, establishing Polpharma Biologics and backing research and production facilities for biosimilars. Beyond the group, he created the Polpharma Scientific Foundation to fund medical and pharmaceutical research. The Starak Family Foundation also makes the family's collection of modern Polish art publicly accessible and supports young students and artists.
